verdict.rationale: Runpod Pods explicitly support pulling custom containers from any compatible registry (Docker Hub, GHCR, ECR) or selecting official templates, with full SSH/JupyterLab/VS Code access to the running environment, and CLI/API/console management of templates and pods. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of deploying a fully custom Docker image end-to-end (only docs/probe evidence, plus community notes that the execution environment is somewhat locked down for advanced networking use cases).
